biography.plain_text: Zeki Konukoğlu is a Turkish industrialist and honorary president of SANKO Holding. Born Zekeriye Konukoğlu in Gaziantep in 1954, he trained as a textile engineer at Leeds University. His career at the family group spanned textile exports, the growth of ISKO, leadership of its energy business and SANKO's chairmanship from 2014 to 2020.

long_biography.plain_text:
Launching ISKO's Bursa denim operation became one of Zeki Konukoğlu's defining assignments. He led its start-up in the late 1980s and remained president of the business for nearly two decades, helping extend SANKO's textile foundations into a major denim manufacturing platform.

His work later shifted towards diversification. As SANKO invested in energy, Konukoğlu led the energy group while serving as vice-chairman, then succeeded his brother Abdulkadir as holding chairman in 2014. During his tenure the group commissioned hydroelectric, wind and geothermal capacity. He stepped down in 2020, passing the chair to his brother Adil Sani Konukoğlu, and became honorary president.
